description: Source code for QpackInstructionEncoder class, which encodes QPACK instructions for HTTP/3/QPACK compression, including methods for encoding instructions, handling different field types, and string encoding with optional Huffman compression.

classes.name: QpackInstructionEncoder
classes.description: Class responsible for encoding QPACK instructions, managing instruction fields, and string encoding with optional Huffman compression.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a QpackInstructionWithValues into a string output.

methods.name: DoStartField
methods.description: Prepares to encode the next instruction field based on its type.

methods.name: DoVarintEncode
methods.description: Encodes a varint or string length as a varint.

methods.name: DoStartString
methods.description: Prepares string encoding, deciding on Huffman compression.

methods.name: DoWriteString
methods.description: Encodes a string (name or value), with optional Huffman compression.
